audience: online sellers and warehouse teams who manage orders and stock in Veeqo

useCases.title: Find orders that are not shipped yet
useCases.text: The AI lists orders by status, store, tag, text or date, with customer, line items and shipments. You see what still needs to go out.

useCases.title: Find products that are running low on stock
useCases.text: The AI reads products with the physical, allocated and available stock per warehouse, and the low-stock flag of a variant. It lists what to reorder.

useCases.title: Track an order's shipments and returns
useCases.text: The AI reads an order with its tracking numbers and any returns. For shipments with a label bought in Veeqo it reads the tracking events too.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders and what was received
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders with supplier, destination warehouse and ordered and received quantities, and reads one in full. Needs a paid Veeqo plan.

useCases.title: Correct the stock level of a product
useCases.text: The AI sets the physical stock of one variant in one warehouse after a count, and can set its bin location. It overwrites the current quantity.

useCases.title: Add a note to an order or tag orders
useCases.text: The AI adds an internal note to an order, or applies existing tags to up to 50 orders at once. Notes are seen by your team, not the customer.
